sv.title: Telefonstrul sinkar tågen
sv.summary: Ett problem med Trafikverkets telefonisystem orsakar förseningar i tågtrafiken runtom i Sverige, rapporterar Aftonbladet.

en.title: Phone glitch delays trains
en.summary: A problem with the Transport Administration's telephone system is causing delays to rail traffic across Sweden, reports Aftonbladet.
